### Installer versions and companion files

Import an EXE or release ZIP as a normal version, then enable **Locate the game after setup**. Installer files and the files players supply to setup are now separate. A companion can come from a pinned library version or from an approved server path. Installer versions can also pin the emulator used when the player presses **Play**.

**Update Drop Desktop, Drop Server, and Torrential together** to use this feature. The version and manifest APIs now carry installer intent, companion metadata, and setup-to-emulator bindings. Older desktops are explicitly blocked from downloading versions that require the new installer flow. Existing loose-file bundles continue to work without re-importing them. The updated server image includes the matching Torrential build.

For filesystem companions, mount the source at the same absolute path for Drop Server and Torrential, and set `DROP_INSTALLER_COMPANION_ROOTS` on the server. Leave this unset if you do not want to allow filesystem companions.
